bull_bear.body:
- Growth is equity-funded: the Rs 725 Cr Jan-2025 preferential raise funds the Rs 310 Cr Rajkot capex, and the deck states "Moderate working capital expansion to support growth, fully funded through the fund raise already concluded."
- Portfolio pruning post change-of-control: Wintal Machines SRL filed for Judicial Liquidation in Dec-24 and Rcube Energy Storage Systems was sold in Feb-25.
- Capital recycling through monetization of legacy assets for more than Rs 300 Cr following consolidation into the single Rajkot plant.
- Balance sheet snapshot moves with the build-out: FY26 total debt Rs 79.8 Cr (FY25 Rs 10.0 Cr), cash & equivalents Rs 33.9 Cr (FY25 Rs 93.8 Cr), inventories Rs 215.2 Cr (FY25 Rs 144.2 Cr), reserves Rs 475.6 Cr and total assets Rs 883.4 Cr.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Established 1963 with a "60+ Years Legacy", presence in 65+ countries and an installed base of 35k+ machines globally; describes itself as a comprehensive, end-to-end solution provider "from finished machinery to machine tools" across three divisions - CNC, Injection Moulding and Extrusion.
- Vision is "To be a global leader in providing innovative mother machining solutions, driving sustainable growth through technological excellence and customer-centricity."
- Import-substitution pitch: manufacturing high-tonnage machines (up to 3200T) entirely in India; the KL 3200-ton (launched Sep'24) is described as "India's largest locally manufactured Injection Moulding Machine", with the widest tonnage range of 350-3200 tonnes.
- Sep 2024 change of control: Plutus Investments and Holding Pvt. Ltd. acquired a controlling stake (53.9%), which the deck frames as "a significant change of control and strategic direction" and the "Starting of a Multi-decadal Growth Journey".
- Top 10 customer concentration shown as 18% (FY24), 25% (FY25) and 20% (FY26); the deck footnotes that FY24 & FY25 are only for the Injection Moulding & Extrusion divisions.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Anti-dumping] DGTR imposed an anti-dumping duty for 5 years (w.e.f. Jun'25) on Injection Moulding Machines imported from China and Taiwan, with the duty ranging from 0% to 63% of CIF value depending on producer.
- [Leadership] Mr. Mohan Ramachandran joined as Chief Executive Officer this quarter - 32+ years across automotive and industrial manufacturing with leadership roles at Eicher Group, Mahindra & Mahindra, Cummins Technologies and Milacron India.
- [Amalgamation] Global CNC was acquired in Feb'25 and the Board approved its amalgamation effective Apr 1, 2025.
- [Shareholding] As on 5th July 2026: Promoter & Promoter Group 43.9%, Others (Public) 41.6%, Directors 7.6%, Bodies Corporate 4.0%, FPIs 2.3%, AIFs 0.7%.
- [External shock] Management describes Q1FY27 as a quarter that "tested Windsor's operational resilience" due to significant disruption arising from the Middle East conflict, which drove supply-chain-led raw material cost inflation.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Windsor Machines as a 60-year-old "mother machinery" maker spanning CNC machine tools, injection moulding and extrusion, relaunched after a Sep-24 change of control, with four legacy plants consolidated into a single integrated Rajkot facility and capacity lifted from 1,500 to 3,600 machines p.a. (expandable to 8,400).

themes.title: Capital-goods & machine-tool import-substitution
themes.need: Atmanirbhar machine-tool and heavy-engineering localization is supply-constrained against import-substituting demand. JYOTICNC runs >100% utilization with a INR4,732cr order book and near-triples capacity; ELGIEQUIP/CUMMINSIND/ELECON/LMW ride the same capex + export + China+1 pull; ISGEC/BHEL/GMMPFAUDLR/KIRLPNU on process + energy capex.
themes.driver: Capacity expansion going live (JYOTICNC); defence/EMS order conversion; US-reshoring export demand (ELGIEQUIP).

themes.title: Specialty packaging & sustainable materials
themes.need: Premiumization, e-commerce and a sustainability/recycling mandate drive a packaging up-cycle across flexible films, rigid plastics, cartons and compostables. UFLEX/EPL/HUHTAMAKI/COSMOFIRST/ESTER on films/tubes; TCPLPACK/AGI/BOROLTD on cartons/glass; MOLDTKPAC/MOLDTECH on rigid/IML; PAKKA/GANECOS on compostable & recycled materials.
themes.driver: Brand-owner restocking; export demand recovery; recycled-content mandates; commodity-cost pass-through.
